summary: The voyage now spawns the pilot in the vessel their squad seat names (written to NetDefaultVesselType before Voyage.unity loads), not the menu's attract hull; still no swap after spawn, so the 2026-10-31 Manta hand-off problem is not reintroduced. VoyageScene also ends a voyage still out when the scene loader starts leaving, before vessels despawn. Milestone 1 (Shombith, 2026-11-16).
